verses.3: And he passed over before them, and bowed himself to the ground seven times, until he came near to his brother.
verses.5: And he lifted up his eyes, and saw the women and the children; and said, Who are those with thee? And he said, The children which God hath graciously given thy servant.
verses.6: Then the handmaidens came near, they and their children, and they bowed themselves.
verses.8: And he said, What meanest thou by all this drove which I met? And he said, These are to find grace in the sight of my lord.
verses.11: Take, I pray thee, my blessing that is brought to thee; because God hath dealt graciously with me, and because I have enough. And he urged him, and he took it.
verses.12: And he said, Let us take our journey, and let us go, and I will go before thee.
verses.13: And he said unto him, My lord knoweth that the children are tender, and the flocks and herds with young are with me: and if men should overdrive them one day, all the flock will die.
verses.14: Let my lord, I pray thee, pass over before his servant: and I will lead on softly, according as the cattle that goeth before me and the children be able to endure, until I come unto my lord unto
